title: Replace one Space's complete mutable details without changing scope or child state

requirements.invariant: UpdateSpaceDetails owns one stable SpaceID and replaces the complete mutable name-and-optional-notes pair. Name is outer-trimmed and nonblank; notes are outer-trimmed with nil/whitespace-only meaning absent; accepted interior text is preserved, no unapproved length cap is invented and duplicate names remain valid.

Details update cannot change the immutable Project-or-Business-Inventory scope and cannot become a partial/generic field update. One exact expected Space revision makes stale intent an explicit conflict rather than last-write-wins.

Updating Space details cannot create or change a checklist, template, attachment, Item assignment, review note, completion/lifecycle state, Transaction, occurrence, Invoice, budget contribution, payer, price or other accounting state.

UpdateSpaceDetails is distinct from CreateSpace, ReviseSpaceChecklists, assignment, archive, review-note and template operations. It replaces current generic field dictionaries and client-authored updatedAt behavior with one typed intent.
UpdateSpaceDetails is one typed business intent and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection/path/SQL string, CRUD action, server timestamp, scope override, lifecycle toggle or backend SDK type.

The complete details replacement is bound to one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared fingerprint/receipt lifecycle and defines no competing queue, retry, result or rejection semantics.

One narrow backend-neutral Space-details operation accepts the validated command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or stable failure. It carries exactly one same-Space expected-revision precondition; local validation never substitutes for trusted membership, Space existence/revision or update authorization.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no Space table/handler, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ExpectedSpaceRevision is one UInt64 authoritative revision value and adds no client-authored row, timestamp or conflict outcome.

SpaceDetailsUpdateDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation contract, stable Space, complete canonical SpaceDisplayName/SpaceCreationNotes replacement, expected Space revision and finite capture time; it contains no scope/checklist/template/attachment/Item/review/lifecycle/completion/accounting input.

UpdateSpaceDetailsPayload contains only SpaceID and the complete canonical name/notes pair. UpdateSpaceDetailsCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the Space subject/fingerprint and exactly one same-subject expected-revision precondition, and revalidates duplicated evidence on decode.

SpaceDetailsUpdating is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt. Receipt validation requires exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative updated-row/result claim; stable failures cover bindings, revision preconditions, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local acceptance and malformed evidence.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no spaces table, details/revision/audit column, foreign key, check, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative UpdateSpaceDetails handler, membership/Space lookup, revision lock, idempotency storage, audit timestamp, conflict result or server update exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/Space binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, grant, WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Space row/details projection, optimistic overlay, upload connector or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact same-Space expected-revision precondition, Space subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same name/notes/binding validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Changed Account, actor, contract, Space/name/notes payload, revision subject/value/count, command subject, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity or converting details into a generic Space update.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic row, authoritative apply or offline-authorization evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: UpdateSpaceDetails owns no AttachmentID/reference/bytes/retention behavior and cannot add, replace, detach, reorder or delete Space media; O-023 remains open.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Space edit UI, current app service, target MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Space document/generic field update, source export or details migration is decoded or transformed. Later migration must preserve/canonicalize Space name/notes with explicit identity/scope/revision evidence.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot visibly or authoritatively update a Space, change its scope, create/revise child state, assign Items, attach media, set completion, archive/delete, alter accounting, authorize membership, choose Auth, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-023/O-026/O-037, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic set and clear inputs produce one typed exact-scope UpdateSpaceDetails command with complete canonical name/notes and one same-Space revision, containing no scope/checklist/template/attachment/Item/review/lifecycle/completion/accounting/generic-write input.

Set and clear commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Space/name/notes/revision/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no scope override, backend path, provider, credential or authoritative result claim.

Blank/noncanonical name, noncanonical notes, invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Space/name/notes/revision subject/value/count/command subject/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, same OperationID with changed Space/name/notes/revision is refused, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 Space-details command only. The canonical Space spec and reviewed capability dossier preserve edit outcomes while replacing generic partial dictionaries with one complete revisioned name/notes intent. O-023/O-026/O-037 remain fully open because this command carries no media, templates, assignment or lifecycle concern. The slice stops before physical durable storage, authoritative server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
